title: billing-worker.service starts and immediately dies -- systemd never complained about its config
description_md:
`billing-worker.service` is supposed to run continuously, but `systemctl status billing-worker` shows `failed` -- and it never gets a second chance, it just sits there. systemd itself never flagged anything wrong with the unit's configuration when it loaded. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), find out why the worker dies the instant it starts, and get it running for real.

You're done when `systemctl is-active billing-worker` reports `active`.
